description: Use to find the entity id to search within, brief on or post under: businesses, places (cities, airports, venues), products, websites, apps, services and workflow topics. Free, no token needed. Pass query to match names ("JFK", "Barcelona", "parking") or type to filter; results come 25 at a time (pass the returned next value as after). Places: filter by ISO country, schema.org kind, a shared identifier you already hold (wikidata, osm, iata, unlocode: also finds places not yet listed, so check before adding one) or near a point; place results carry address, coordinates and identifiers. If nothing fits, add it with create_entity.

after.description: Cursor from a previous call's next value

country.description: Places only: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, e.g. US, GB, JP

iata.description: Places only: IATA code, e.g. JFK

kind.description: Places only: schema.org place type, e.g. Airport, TrainStation, ShoppingCenter, Museum, City

near.description: Places only: 'lat,lng' in decimal degrees; returns the nearest places with distance_km

osm.description: Places only: OpenStreetMap element, e.g. way/123456

query.description: Optional text to match in entity names, ids or descriptions

radius_km.description: Places only: search radius for near (default 10)

type.description: Optional filter: PLACE (cities, airports, venues), WORKFLOW (topics such as check-in, navigation, parking), BUSINESS, PRODUCT, WEBSITE, APP or SERVICE

wikidata.description: Places only: Wikidata item id, e.g. Q8685

name: list_entities
title: List known entities
